# GitHub Copilot Instructions - MOVEX-Portal

## Project Overview

**MOVEX-Portal** is a secure, user-friendly web portal that enables internal staff to safely interact with M3 MOVEX API endpoints through a config-driven, role-based access control (RBAC) system with comprehensive ISO 27001-compliant audit logging.

**Technology Stack**: ASP.NET Core 8.0, Razor Pages, Windows Authentication, IIS hosting

---

## Agent Activation

**Primary Agent**: `expert-movex-dotnet`  
**Agent Definition**: `../.github/agents/manufacturing/movex-dotnet.yaml`

This agent provides expertise in:
- M3 MOVEX API integration (MI protocol)
- .NET 8.0 web application development
- Clean architecture patterns
- Security and compliance (ISO 27001)

## Code Generation Guidelines

### Architecture Principles

1. **Skills-Based Implementation**
   - Reference skill specifications before implementing features
   - Follow skill interfaces and patterns exactly
   - Document skill usage in code comments
   - Skills are blueprints; implementation lives in `src/`

2. **Configuration Over Code**
   - Endpoints defined in `src/config/endpoint-registry.json`
   - RBAC roles mapped in `src/config/rbac-config.json`
   - No code deployment needed to add new endpoints
   - Dynamic form generation from endpoint metadata

3. **Security First**
   - Windows Integrated Authentication (AD) mandatory
   - RBAC enforcement at every endpoint execution
   - Sensitive data auto-masked in audit logs (credentials, PII)
   - API keys scoped with expiry and automatic rotation
   - Network isolation (on-premises only, IP allowlist)

4. **Audit Everything**
   - Log every endpoint call: WHO, WHAT, WHEN, INPUT, OUTPUT, RESULT
   - Immutable audit trail with cryptographic integrity
   - Retention by risk level: CRITICAL=7yrs, HIGH=3yrs, MEDIUM=1yr, LOW=90days
   - ISO 27001 compliance built-in

src/

## Technology-Specific Standards

### ASP.NET Core 8.0

**Use:**
- Minimal APIs for admin endpoints (simple CRUD)
- Razor Pages for portal UI (server-rendered forms)
- Clean Architecture: Pages → Controllers → Services → Infrastructure
- Dependency Injection with `IServiceCollection`

**Configuration:**
```csharp
// Program.cs
var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

// Authentication
builder.Services.AddAuthentication(IISDefaults.AuthenticationScheme);
builder.Services.AddAuthorization();

// Services implementing skills
builder.Services.AddScoped<IEndpointExecutor, EndpointExecutorService>();  // SKILL: generic-endpoint-executor
builder.Services.AddScoped<IRbacService, RbacService>();                   // SKILL: rbac-endpoint-control
builder.Services.AddSingleton<IAuditService, AuditService>();              // SKILL: audit-logging-framework
builder.Services.AddScoped<IM3TransactionBuilder, M3TransactionBuilder>(); // SKILL: m3-transaction-builder
builder.Services.AddScoped<IM3ResponseParser, M3ResponseParser>();         // SKILL: m3-response-parser

// Middleware order
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();
app.UseMiddleware<RbacMiddleware>();     // RBAC enforcement
app.UseMiddleware<AuditMiddleware>();    // Audit logging
app.UseMiddleware<ExceptionMiddleware>(); // Error handling
```

### Windows Authentication

```csharp
// Access user identity
var windowsIdentity = User.Identity as WindowsIdentity;
var username = User.Identity?.Name; // DOMAIN\username

// Extract AD groups for RBAC
var groups = windowsIdentity?.Groups?
    .Select(g => g.Translate(typeof(NTAccount)).ToString())
    .ToList();
```

### Razor Pages (Dynamic Forms)

```cshtml
@* Pages/Execute.cshtml *@
@page "/execute/{endpointId}"
@model ExecuteModel

<h2>@Model.EndpointDefinition.DisplayName</h2>
<p>@Model.EndpointDefinition.Description</p>

<form method="post">
    @* Dynamically generate form fields from endpoint metadata *@
    @foreach (var field in Model.EndpointDefinition.InputFields)
    {
        <div class="form-group">
            <label asp-for="@field.Name">@field.Label</label>
            <input type="@field.HtmlInputType" 
                   class="form-control" 
                   name="@field.Name" 
                   maxlength="@field.MaxLength"
                   required="@field.Required" />
            <span class="text-muted">@field.HelpText</span>
        </div>
    }
    
    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Execute</button>
</form>

@* Display results *@
@if (Model.ExecutionResult != null)
{
    <div class="alert alert-@(Model.ExecutionResult.Success ? "success" : "danger")">
        <strong>@(Model.ExecutionResult.Success ? "Success" : "Error")</strong>
        <pre>@Model.ExecutionResult.Output</pre>
    </div>
}
```

## Logging Standards (Serilog)

### Structured Logging

```csharp
// Good: Structured properties
_logger.LogInformation(
    "Endpoint {EndpointId} executed by {User} with result {Success} in {ElapsedMs}ms",
    endpointId,
    user.Identity.Name,
    result.Success,
    elapsed.TotalMilliseconds);

// Bad: String interpolation
_logger.LogInformation($"User {user.Identity.Name} executed {endpointId}");
```

### Audit Log Format

```csharp
public class AuditLogEntry
{
    public Guid AuditId { get; set; }
    public DateTime Timestamp { get; set; }
    public string Username { get; set; }         // DOMAIN\username
    public string EndpointId { get; set; }       // Endpoint identifier
    public string Action { get; set; }           // "EXECUTE", "VIEW", "ADMIN"
    public string InputParameters { get; set; }  // Masked sensitive data
    public string Output { get; set; }           // Masked sensitive data
    public bool Success { get; set; }
    public string ErrorMessage { get; set; }
    public string IpAddress { get; set; }
    public int DurationMs { get; set; }
    public string RiskLevel { get; set; }        // CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW
}
```

## Testing Standards

### xUnit Test Structure

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Tests for EndpointExecutorService
/// SKILL: generic-endpoint-executor
/// </summary>
public class EndpointExecutorServiceTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IRbacService> _mockRbac;
    private readonly Mock<IAuditService> _mockAudit;
    private readonly Mock<IM3TransactionBuilder> _mockBuilder;
    private readonly EndpointExecutorService _executor;

    public EndpointExecutorServiceTests()
    {
        _mockRbac = new Mock<IRbacService>();
        _mockAudit = new Mock<IAuditService>();
        _mockBuilder = new Mock<IM3TransactionBuilder>();
        _executor = new EndpointExecutorService(_mockRbac.Object, _mockAudit.Object, _mockBuilder.Object);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ExecuteAsync_UserHasPermission_ExecutesSuccessfully()
    {
        // Arrange
        var user = CreateTestUser("DOMAIN\\testuser", new[] { "Inventory_Read" });
        var endpointId = "get-item-basic";
        var parameters = new Dictionary<string, object> { { "ITNO", "ABC123" } };

        _mockRbac.Setup(r => r.UserHasAccess(user, endpointId)).ReturnsAsync(true);

        // Act
        var result = await _executor.ExecuteAsync(endpointId, parameters, user);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(result.Success);
        _mockAudit.Verify(a => a.LogAsync(It.IsAny<AuditLogEntry>()), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task ExecuteAsync_UserLacksPermission_ThrowsUnauthorized()
    {
        // Arrange
        var user = CreateTestUser("DOMAIN\\testuser", Array.Empty<string>());
        var endpointId = "update-stock-balance";

        _mockRbac.Setup(r => r.UserHasAccess(user, endpointId)).ReturnsAsync(false);

        // Act & Assert
        await Assert.ThrowsAsync<UnauthorizedAccessException>(
            () => _executor.ExecuteAsync(endpointId, new Dictionary<string, object>(), user));
    }
}
```

## Security Standards

### Input Validation (FluentValidation)

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// Validates endpoint parameters against metadata
/// SKILL: generic-endpoint-executor
/// </summary>
public class EndpointParameterValidator : AbstractValidator<Dictionary<string, object>>
{
    public EndpointParameterValidator(EndpointDefinition endpoint)
    {
        foreach (var field in endpoint.InputFields)
        {
            RuleFor(p => p[field.Name])
                .NotEmpty().When(_ => field.Required)
                .WithMessage($"{field.Label} is required");

            if (field.Type == "string" && field.MaxLength > 0)
            {
                RuleFor(p => p[field.Name].ToString())
                    .MaximumLength(field.MaxLength)
                    .WithMessage($"{field.Label} must not exceed {field.MaxLength} characters");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(field.Validation))
            {
                RuleFor(p => p[field.Name].ToString())
                    .Matches(field.Validation)
                    .WithMessage($"{field.Label} format is invalid");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

    {
        var obj = JsonDocument.Parse(json);
        var maskedObj = MaskObject(obj.RootElement);
        return JsonSerializer.Serialize(maskedObj);
    }
